title: War rig chase across the salt flats
place: Blinding white salt flats under a bleached sky, an armored tanker truck roaring ahead of a swarm of spiked buggies and dirt bikes
situation: A tanker convoy runs a gauntlet as raiders leap between vehicles on poles while a masked guitarist on a speaker truck plays flames
cast: grizzled drifter tied to a hood
visualTropes: a tanker swerving through a sandstorm
jokeHooks: the raiders board the tanker one by one like merge conflicts piling onto a long-lived branch
the flame guitarist plays nonstop like an alert nobody can silence
the rig's fuel gauge is a progress bar stuck at 99 percent

title: Scrap market bazaar
place: A bustling market built inside a crashed airliner and old shipping containers, tarps overhead, stalls selling bottle caps, batteries and canned beans
situation: Scroungers haggle loudly over salvage; a trader swears an old circuit board still works while a crowd gathers to test it
cast: kid with a pet two-headed lizard
visualTropes: strings of fairy lights powered by bicycles
goggles pushed up on dusty foreheads
jokeHooks: the trader sells a package marked works great, last updated before the collapse
everyone pays in bottle caps but the change comes in deprecated coins
the circuit board works only on the trader's own machine

title: Cage arena duel
place: A rust-domed scrap arena packed with screaming spectators hanging off the bars, two fighters dangling on bungee harnesses inside
situation: Two champions bounce around on elastic harnesses grabbing weapons off the cage while a flamboyant ruler announces the one rule
visualTropes: chainsaws and hammers hanging from the bars
a chanting crowd silhouetted on the dome
a gong struck by a muscleman
jokeHooks: two developers enter the merge conflict and only one change leaves
the announced single rule is longer than the style guide
the brute is a legacy test suite nobody can defeat in under an hour

title: Leaving the vault for the first time
place: A gear-shaped steel vault door rolling aside in a hillside, blinding light spilling in over a ruined suburb and a radioactive sunset
situation: A sheltered vault dweller in a blue jumpsuit steps out with a wrist computer and a cheerful attitude into a hostile wasteland
jokeHooks: the dweller emerges with documentation two centuries out of date
the wrist computer requests a firmware update in the middle of an ambush
everything outside fails the dweller's environment checks

title: Failing bunker reactor
place: A deep concrete bunker's reactor chamber, pipes hissing steam, flickering caged bulbs, a hand-painted sign reading DO NOT TOUCH
situation: The bunker's last generator is failing and only an ancient manual written by the previous occupants explains how to fix it
visualTropes: a manual held together with tape
jokeHooks: the manual's fix says see page 40, which was torn out years ago, like a dead doc link
a sticky note on the valve says temporary fix, dated decades back
the reactor is held together by one undocumented hack nobody dares remove

title: Trek through a ruined skyline
place: An overgrown city where vines swallow skyscrapers, a highway snaps off midair, and deer graze in a flooded avenue
situation: A small band crosses the city on foot, climbing collapsed buildings and following faded street signs that lead to dead ends
visualTropes: a highway ending in thin air
jokeHooks: the map is cached from before the collapse and every route is wrong
the faded sign points to a service that was shut down years ago
the group takes a shortcut through an abandoned module nobody maintains

title: Gyrocopter scout over the dunes
place: Hot open sky above red dunes, a rickety homemade gyrocopter sputtering over a convoy, a dust storm chasing from behind
situation: A goofy pilot scouts ahead, dropping notes and snakes, while the rotor loses bolts and the storm swallows the horizon
cast: convoy boss shouting from a truck
visualTropes: a rotor wobbling and shedding bolts
a snake peeking from a basket
jokeHooks: the scout reports all clear from a status page that has not refreshed
the gyrocopter drops one bolt per minute like a slow memory leak
messages arrive tied to rocks, out of order

title: Standoff at the last water tower
place: A rusted water tower on stilts in a dusty town, rival gangs on rooftops on either side, the tower's single tap dripping
situation: Two gangs claim the town's only water; everyone draws scrap weapons while a kid quietly fixes the tap that leaks precious water
jokeHooks: two teams fight over the one shared staging environment
the kid fixes the real leak while everyone argues about ownership
the tower's capacity is a quota nobody can raise without a ticket

title: Crossing the glowing swamp
place: A fog-choked swamp glowing green, half-sunken school buses, giant mutant frogs on lily pads the size of cars
situation: A party rafts across the swamp on a door; every ripple might be a mutant, and the geiger counter clicks faster with each paddle
visualTropes: a school bus roof as an island
jokeHooks: the geiger counter clicks like a log stream full of warnings everyone ignores
the raft is a quick fix that has been in production for years
every safe-looking lily pad is a dependency with a hidden vulnerability

title: Escape on a rail handcart
place: A collapsing railway through a canyon, a pump handcart racing downhill, raiders chasing on motorbikes along the ridge
situation: Two survivors pump a handcart at full speed toward a broken bridge while raiders leap from the ridge onto the tracks
visualTropes: a bridge with a missing section ahead
jokeHooks: the bridge ahead is missing exactly the piece the change log said was done
pumping faster only makes the build fail faster
the raiders are notifications that keep jumping on board

title: Siege at the junkyard fortress
place: A walled settlement built from stacked cars and tires, a gate made of a bus, raider vehicles circling with flaming catapults
situation: Defenders hold the gate while raiders lob flaming junk over the walls; the settlement's alarm horn keeps jamming
cast: raider warlord in a hockey mask
visualTropes: a bus rolling aside as a gate
a horn duct-taped to a pole
jokeHooks: the gate is guarded by a firewall rule nobody remembers adding
the alarm horn goes off on every seagull, so nobody reacts to the real raid
the warlord brute-forces the gate with a battering truck like a password spray

title: Night at the survivor camp
place: A camp beneath a ruined overpass, oil-drum fires, patched tents, a crowd sharing stew around a radio that crackles with static
situation: Survivors gather to hear a mysterious broadcast promising safety in the north, and argue whether it is real or a trap
visualTropes: a radio antenna made of coat hangers
jokeHooks: the broadcast is an automated message that has been looping since the end, like a stale cron job
everyone trusts the rumor because it has many stars
the newcomer claims it will fix everything with one install

title: Frozen seed vault
place: A tunnel into an icy mountain, frost-covered racks of labeled boxes, a frozen control terminal blinking on emergency power
situation: Explorers reach a legendary seed vault to restart farming, but the boxes are labeled in an indexing system nobody understands
cast: librarian who knows the old codes
visualTropes: a squirrel stuffing seeds in its cheeks
jokeHooks: the index is sorted by a hash function nobody can reverse
the backup exists, but nobody ever tested restoring it
the squirrel is a background job silently eating storage

title: Convoy caught in a dust storm
place: A long convoy of patched buses, trucks and a sailing land-yacht on a cracked highway, a wall of brown dust swallowing the sun
situation: The convoy must keep moving blind through the storm, linked by a rope and shouted relays from vehicle to vehicle
cast: convoy captain on a bus roof
tired family in a station wagon
visualTropes: a sail full of brown wind
jokeHooks: shouted relays mangle the instructions like a long chain of tool calls
every vehicle waits on the slowest one, like a pipeline waiting on its flakiest job
the convoy follows the rope even after it is tied to the wrong truck
